sources.title: Environment Agency Pollution Inventory - National Data Library
facts: Environment Agency Pollution Inventory provides annual mass-release data for large regulated industrial sites.
The dataset surface lists downloadable annual files through 2024.
Reporting can include point, non-point and fugitive releases across the regulated permit scope.

sources.title: UK ETS reports and scheme reviews
facts: The UK ETS Authority collection contains scheme and compliance data.
It separates allocation tables, HSE emissions and targets, reviews and registry reports.
Allowance allocation and compliance evidence are not parcel-level physical emissions measurements.

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Registry public reports
facts: The public Registry compliance report covers emissions and UK allowances surrendered for scheme years 2021 to 2025.
The registry also publishes account-holder and transaction reports on separate schedules.
Surrendered allowances and transactions must not be substituted for measured parcel emissions.

sources.title: NAEI Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data
facts: NAEI lists the 2026 UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory covering 1990 to 2024.
The page distinguishes source, end-user, point-source, gridded and local-authority products.
Different geography and accounting products must remain separate during matching.

sources.title: NAEI reports
facts: NAEI reports list the UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990 to 2024 with report date 30 April 2026.
Devolved greenhouse-gas inventories for 1990 to 2024 are listed with report date 9 June 2026.
Inventory reports are aggregate evidence and do not establish a canonical parcel measurement by themselves.

sources.title: NAEI emissions data portal
facts: NAEI provides emissions selectors, emission factors, maps and downloadable greenhouse-gas datasets.
The portal identifies Defra and DESNZ annual statistics as the publication context.
Emission factors and maps require explicit method and geography handling before any downstream calculation.

sources.title: Environment Agency 2024 data on regulated businesses in England
facts: Environment Agency publishes regulated-business datasets covering compliance, Pollution Inventory, incidents, enforcement and waste crime for 2024.
The page applies to England and describes dataset-specific licensing conditions.
Compliance or incident records are not direct greenhouse-gas measurements unless a linked emissions dataset says so.

sources.title: IED environmental permits issued 2026 A to F
facts: Environment Agency publishes 2026 Industrial Emissions Directive permit decisions for sites A to F.
Entries identify operators, postcodes and permit identifiers.
A permit decision proves regulatory continuity or scope, not an emissions quantity.

sources.title: IED environmental permits issued 2026 G to L
facts: Environment Agency publishes 2026 Industrial Emissions Directive permit decisions for sites G to L.
The collection includes dated permit variations, surrenders and issued permits.
Permit existence must be kept separate from measured or reported greenhouse-gas emissions.

sources.title: Technical guidance for regulated industry sectors: environmental permitting
facts: Environment Agency maintains sector-specific environmental permitting technical guidance.
The collection spans combustion, waste, chemicals, metals and other regulated activities.
Sector guidance is methodology and regulatory evidence rather than an observed emissions row.

sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance: Monitoring and Reporting Regulation 2018
facts: UK ETS MRR guidance covers monitoring, reporting, biomass, data-flow controls and sampling.
The 5 May 2026 update revised voluntary waste-MRV guidance with preliminary and biomass-fraction emission factors.
Guidance and factors must not be treated as an observed facility or parcel emissions measurement.

sources.title: Environment Agency greenhouse gas emissions charging scheme
facts: The charging scheme states charges applying from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.
Charges cover permit and emissions-monitoring-plan applications plus UK ETS and registry administration activities.
Charging or permit administration is policy evidence, not physical emissions evidence.

sources.title: UK ETS for installations: how to comply
facts: Environment Agency and DESNZ guidance explains UK ETS obligations for installations with greenhouse-gas emissions permits.
The 2026 update reflects METS, deficit notices and the separate 2026 allocation period.
Operators must use factors for the relevant scheme year when approved monitoring plans allow default factors.

sources.title: Climate change agreements scheme - carbon emissions factor for gas
facts: HMRC describes changes to how the carbon-emissions factor for gas is described and calculated in the Climate Change Agreements scheme.
This is a policy and calculation-factor source.
A gas factor is not an observed parcel emissions value without activity data and a supported calculation contract.

sources.title: Energy trends and prices July to September 2026 announcement
facts: DESNZ schedules the July to September 2026 Energy Trends and Prices release for 29 September 2026 at 09:30.
The announcement describes future monthly production, trade, generation, consumption and price statistics.
The future release is metadata only and its unreleased values must never be treated as observed.
